name: Hotel Lobby
summary: Front desk, concierge and your ride
details: Check-in, front desk and concierge. We meet here for Sunday’s ride to Secret Beach at 1:15 PM.

name: Kuilima Ballrooms + Meeting Rooms
details: The ballroom wing is just north of the lobby. Breakfast and lunch are in Kuilima 3, the business meetings in Kuilima 2, and one-on-ones in the Maui and Moloka’i Rooms. Tap Go inside to see the exact rooms.

name: Bay View Lawn
details: Saturday’s Welcome Reception, 7 to 9 PM, on the lawn by Bay View Beach. Pick up your registration materials here.

name: Kuilima Point
details: Monday’s Closing Reception, 7 to 9 PM, at the tip of the point with the ocean on both sides.

name: Hotel restaurants
summary: Alaia, Off The Lip and Ho’olana
details: The hotel’s dining is in the West Wing.
hours: Alaia: 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM and 5:00 PM to 9:00 PM (No bathing suits. Reserve on OpenTable or call.); Off The Lip: 12:00 PM to 10:30 PM (Smart casual.); Ho’olana: 5:30 AM to 4:00 PM

name: Sunset Pool Bar
details: Casual drinks and bites by the main pool.
hours: Sunset Pool Bar: 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM

name: Beach House by Roy Yamaguchi
details: Casual dining on the cove.
hours: Beach House: 11:30 AM to 2:30 PM and 4:30 PM to 9:00 PM (Reserve on OpenTable or call.)

name: Lei Lei’s Bar & Grill
details: American fare at the Fazio course clubhouse, south of the hotel.

name: Pools
details: Main and Adult pools are open 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM. The Keiki pool is open 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

name: Nalu Spa + Fitness
details: Nalu Spa is at pool level near the ocean. The fitness center is on the lobby level and open 24 hours.

name: Tennis + pickleball
details: Tennis and pickleball courts.

name: The Stables
details: Horseback riding and the Paniolo Lawn. About a 10-minute walk from the main resort.

name: Valet + parking
details: Valet and self-park are both $48 a day. EV charging is available.

name: Kuilima 2
details: Kuilima Ballroom II, the middle room of the big ballroom at the top of the plan. The business meeting runs 9:00 AM to noon both days.

name: Kuilima 3
details: Kuilima Ballroom III, the east end of the big ballroom. Breakfast is at 8:30 AM and lunch at noon, with one-on-one time at lunch.

name: Maui + Moloka’i Rooms
details: On the east side of the Kahuku Foyer, past the restrooms, next to Kuilima Cove Lawn. Saturday one-on-ones run 10:00 AM to 5:30 PM, and Sunday and Monday are as scheduled.

name: Main Lobby
summary: Reception, concierge and the way in
details: Reception and the concierge desk are here. Everything on this plan is a short walk from the lobby, and the ballrooms are straight back through the elevator atrium and the foyers.

name: Concierge
details: Ask here about restaurant reservations, activities and anything else you need.

name: Alaia
details: Hawaiian comfort fare with an ocean view.
hours: Alaia: 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM and 5:00 PM to 9:00 PM (No bathing suits. Reserve on OpenTable or call.)

name: Off The Lip
details: The lobby bar, with shareable plates.
hours: Off The Lip: 12:00 PM to 10:30 PM (Smart casual.)

name: Ho’olana
details: Coffee and breakfast on the go.

name: Sunset Pool Bar
details: Casual drinks and bites by the main pool.
hours: Sunset Pool Bar: 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM

name: Nalu Spa + Fitness
summary: West side of the lobby level
details: The spa and relaxation area, and the fitness center, which is open 24 hours.

name: Restrooms by the meeting rooms
details: The closest restrooms to the Maui and Moloka’i Rooms and the Kuilima Foyer.

name: Business Center
details: Printing and a quiet place to work.

name: Valet
details: Valet is $48 a day.
